note: Six new legal freelance leads scored 55+ on the 100-point fit+intent model. Dedup checked against legal-freelance-scrape-2026-05-21 through 2026-05-27 and pr-freelance-scrape recent reports. Tower Legal Solutions is the strongest pure fund-formation hit this week — fund side letters and feeder fund formation work at $80–120/hr is right at Katie's ICP. Sleep Doctor is a healthtech fractional GC posted via Greenhouse on May 18; commercial contracts and compliance scope make it a decent secondary fit even though it isn't a fund.
